title: Engram bootstrap legibility: missing module header, stale wait-helper contract comment, architecture doc not updated
outcome:
Claude review session-6531, Low findings at src/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs:1,
src/codex.rs:952 and docs/architecture.md:1007. Grouped because they are one
theme: the change is not yet legible to the next reader.

1. src/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs has NO FILE HEADER. CLAUDE.md requires new
   modules to state what they own, what they deliberately do not own, and their
   provenance. The invariants a future reader most needs are exactly the ones
   not written down: the writer thread never blocks on the read, the setup slot
   stays claimed across it, both the waiter and the writer re-check currency
   before acting, and a failure fails the newest parked turn and releases the
   slot for retry.
2. wait_for_shared_codex_response_while_server_active still documents itself as
   "Only used for requests a busy server can legitimately answer late (thread
   setup, turn/start)". config/read is now a THIRD caller. The stale enumeration
   invites the next reader to mis-scope the helper - which matters because a
   separate item is precisely about whether its budget suits that new caller.
3. docs/architecture.md was not updated: the fire-and-forget prompt-flow
   paragraph still describes new-thread setup as one thread/start write plus one
   waiter with no config/read round trip or StartThreadAfterConfig command; the
   per-file source map omits src/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs; and the Codex RPC
   list predates config/read.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
